$comment: COMPLETED instance of model-comparison-schema.json (R12 subtask), filled from a real live run against the DIAL API on 2026-08-29. model-comparison-run-template.json itself was left unmodified (still all-PENDING) per its own instruction to copy-then-fill; this is that copy. Full raw responses (one file per run) live alongside this file in evaluation/runs/, named 20260829T193452Z-<deployment>-run<N>.json. Verbatim quotes backing every FAIL verdict and every genericTemplatedClaimsFlagged/blindSpots entry are in evaluation/RESULTS.md's R12 section, not duplicated here in full. Rescored 2026-09-24 for a scoring inconsistency found by review: gpt-4o run 2's citations to lines 17 and 30 were mis-cited (off by one line and by three lines respectively) with accurate underlying substance, the same defect other runs' off-by-one citations were already scored as not-false for; both now carry verifiedAgainstFile:true plus a verificationNote, leaving gpt-4o run 2 with 2 verified-false claims (not 4) - see each entry's verificationNote and the run's own notes field. The verdict (FAIL) and the reversedVerdicts entry are unchanged: 2 new false claims not present in run 1 still fails README.md's own rule.

scoringMethod.passRule: pass = net-accurate findings (every cited line/claim verified against the actual file)
scoringMethod.failRule: fail = a new false claim not present in the model's other run
verificationSteps: Verify every cited line/claim in the run's findings against the actual sourceFile content.
Flag generic/templated claims that sound true for almost any class but were not specifically checked against this file.
Compare the two runs for the same deployment for a reversed PASS/FAIL verdict on the identical file.
Log blind spots: real issues present in sourceFile that this run's model missed.
